description: Scans a live Kubernetes environment with `mirrord dump` to find an identifier mirrord can filter traffic on: a header, a `baggage` or `tracestate` member, a tenant or user id, a trace id (W3C, B3, X-Ray, Google, Jaeger), a JWT claim, a cookie, a path segment, or a JSON body field that is present on every hop of a request chain, unique to one developer's traffic, and settable by that developer. Runs mirror-only dumps on each service, sends a tagged probe request at the edge or observes real traffic, scores the candidates, and produces the matching `http_filter` (regex, jq on headers, path, method, body, or combinations) plus a per-hop report of where each identifier is dropped. Installs the mirrord CLI through a package manager when it is missing. Use when the user asks what to filter on, whether the cluster already propagates a request id or trace context, how to isolate their own requests on a shared staging cluster, how to filter on a JWT or cookie with mirrord, or wants to inspect live traffic with mirrord dump. Changes no application code: propagation gaps go to the mirrord-header-propagation skill.
